name: 70560 · New Iberia, LA
findings: ZIP 70560 (New Iberia) has 93 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70560 (New Iberia) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 70560 (New Iberia) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).
